Alex Carter: FYI — customer reports promo code rejected as invalid right after accepting an org invite. Repro steps pasted below, requesting billing + eng look. cc @Maria Lopez
Priya Narang: Which code/offer is this? partner credit or trial grant?
Alex Carter: Code is NEWCOMER-30D (30-day trial credit). User accepted invite -> landed on billing page -> tried to apply -> saw 'Invalid or expired code'. API call returns 400.
Samir Patel: Can you paste the exact request/response + account id (masked ok)? Also did they have an existing paid seat before the invite?
Alex Carter: Paste:```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/promos/redeem -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx' -d '{"code":"NEWCOMER-30D","account_id":"acct_3Xx9***"}'```Response:```HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request{ "error": "invalid_code", "message": "Code invalid or expired" }```User said they had a free account and no prior credits. They accepted org invite which merged them into org acct_6Zy2***.
Maria Lopez: I looked up NEWCOMER-30D in promo table: row exists, status = ACTIVE, expires_at = 2027-01-01. But there's an "eligible_org_id" column set to the original inviter org (org_OLD123). The redemption logic checks current_account.org_id only. If the user was merged into a different org id on accept, the check fails.
Priya Narang: Ah ok that matches other edgecases. I'll try to repro: create personal account, invite to org, accept invite, then redeem.
deploy-bot: Canary run: billing-service v2.13.4 health OK (2026-03-15T09:12:00Z). No promo-service errors detected in logs in last hour.
Priya Narang: Repro steps: created test user, accepted invite, tried to redeem NEWCOMER-30D => same 400 invalid_code. Confirmed org id changed on merge (legacy_account_id preserved in user_joins table).
Samir Patel: Thanks. Looks like redemption only checks promo.eligible_org_id == account.org_id. We should fallback to checking legacy_account_id(s) for merged users. I'll file an ENG ticket.
Maria Lopez: For this specific customer I applied manual credit to account acct_6Zy2*** and left note. Customer confirmed credit appeared.
Samir Patel: Created ticket ENG-3923: "Promo redemption should consult legacy/merged account ids when evaluating eligibility". Assigning to payments-team. Tags: billing, promo, urgent.
Alex Carter: Marking customer resolved for now. Please post ETA on ENG-3923 here once triaged. :thumbsup:
Priya Narang: Will follow up with a small unit-test + migration plan. ETA for patch: ~48h after triage.
Alex Carter: Thanks all — closing loop with customer now.
